description: CPU-optimized, privacy-preserving enterprise RAG pipeline utilizing hybrid BM25 + dense ONNX vector embeddings with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) and local ONNX Small Language Model generation.

retrieval.lexical: Okapi BM25 with token expansion and sub-word matching
retrieval.fusion: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF, k=60, dynamic category weighting)

generation.context_distillation: 350-token salient evidence extractor with strict context grounding
